mapper.select: SELECT pc.id AS potentialCustomerId, -- 잠재고객 ID pc.name AS customerName, -- 자녀 이름 pc.gender AS gender, -- 자녀 성별 TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, pc.birth_date, CURDATE()) AS age, -- 자녀 만 나이 계산 pc.birth_date AS birthDate, -- 자녀 생년월일 ic.name AS guardianName, -- 부모 이름 pc.relationship_code AS guardianRelationshipCode, -- 가족관계 코드 cc.code_name AS guardianRelationshipName, -- 가족관계 코드명 조회(부/모) TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, ic.birth_date, CURDATE()) AS guardianAge, -- 부모 생년월일 기준 만 나이 계산 ic.phone AS guardianPhone, -- 부모 연락처 pc.is_active AS isActive, -- 졸업 여부 pc.created_at AS createdAt -- 생성일시 FROM potential_customer pc -- 부모(통합고객) 테이블 조인 INNER JOIN integrated_customer ic ON pc.parent_customer_id = ic.integrated_customer_id -- 가족관계 메타코드 조인 INNER JOIN common_code cc ON pc.relationship_code = cc.code_value AND cc.group_code = 'RELATIONSHIP' -- 로그인한 영업사원의 잠재고객만 조회 WHERE pc.sales_user_id = #{salesUserId} -- 최신 등록순 정렬 ORDER BY pc.is_active ASC, -- 졸업 고객 맨 아래 pc.created_at DESC -- 최신 등록순
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO potential_customer ( parent_customer_id, sales_user_id, relationship_code, name, gender, birth_date, consult_status_code, conversion_status_code ) VALUES ( #{parentCustomerId}, #{salesUserId}, #{relationshipCode}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{birthDate}, '01', '01' )
mapper.select: SELECT pc.id AS potentialCustomerId, pc.parent_customer_id AS parentCustomerId, pc.relationship_code AS relationshipCode, relationship.code_name AS relationshipName, pc.name AS name, pc.gender AS gender, pc.birth_date AS birthDate, pc.consult_status_code AS consultStatusCode, consult.code_name AS consultStatusName, pc.conversion_status_code AS conversionStatusCode, conversion.code_name AS conversionStatusName, pc.created_at AS createdAt FROM potential_customer pc INNER JOIN common_code relationship ON relationship.group_code = 'RELATIONSHIP' AND relationship.code_value = pc.relationship_code INNER JOIN common_code consult ON consult.group_code = 'CONSULT_STATUS' AND consult.code_value = pc.consult_status_code INNER JOIN common_code conversion ON conversion.group_code = 'CONVERSION_STATUS' AND conversion.code_value = pc.conversion_status_code WHERE pc.id = #{potentialCustomerId}

SELECT id, parent_customer_id AS parentCustomerId, sales_user_id AS salesUserId, relationship_code AS relationshipCode, name, gender, birth_date AS birthDate, consult_status_code AS consultStatusCode, conversion_status_code AS conversionStatusCode, created_at AS createdAt, insurance_age_shift_date AS insuranceAgeShiftDate, webform_received_at AS webformReceivedAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM potential_customer WHERE id = #{potentialCustomerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO potential_customer_lifecycle_log ( potential_customer_id, parent_customer_id, sales_user_id, action_type_code, snapshot_data ) VALUES ( #{potentialCustomer.id}, #{potentialCustomer.parentCustomerId}, #{potentialCustomer.salesUserId}, #{actionTypeCode}, #{snapshotData} )
